# Synthetic Node baseline

Generated by `generate-node.mjs` using Node 24.18.0 and the current Drizzle Node
adapter/schema, with synthetic history seeded from the retained Bun fixture.
It includes explicitly fake, unusable instance keys and Host authorization.
`provenance.json` records the tool and baseline commit. No user data is included.
The integration suite copies this directory before opening it with Bun.
